newsitem.title: USA: Airbag safety debate could help stocks - Barron's.
newsitem.headline: Airbag safety debate could help stocks - Barron's.

text.p: A public debate over the safety of air bags in automobiles could help push up the stock price of companies that make the devices, according to the financial weekly tabloid, Barron's.
The tabloid said Breed Technologies Inc, TRW Inc, Magna International Inc and OEA Inc had already seen the price of their stock rising since the beginning of the year.

It said the debate would likely "hasten development of "smart" microprocessor-controlled bags that can calculate an occupant's size and weight and whether a seat belt and shoulder harness are being used, then determine how forcefully to deploy the appropriate airbags".
